name: Zorbi
bio: A fuzzy alien merchant from one of STARWRIGHT's eight species. Has a grudge against bad deals.

portrait.subject: a cute fuzzy purple alien trader with four little eyes, long antennae, a merchant's vest with pockets full of star maps
portrait.background: deep space nebula purple with a distant space station

request: Greetings, Wright! Zorbi the trader, from STARWRIGHT. Friendship is the best trade. Accept? 🌌
hello: Deal sealed! No refunds. (Friendship has no refunds.)
Ask around before you sell. Prices change system to system.
about: I'm Zorbi. My people trade across 230 star systems. Every one grows from a seed. I've been to most of them. Twice.
how: A procedural space sim: fly your ship between 230 star systems, trade, take missions from eight alien species and upgrade your ship.
tips: Buy where it's made, sell where it's wanted.
Learn what each species likes. Gifts open doors.
Share your seed with friends to fly the same galaxy!
chat: Sold a moon rock to a moon. Long story.
My species finds your handshakes alarming.
Found a system where everyone's grumpy. Avoid seed 4441.
nudge: A lucrative mission just opened up. Interested?
idle: {ago} in port! Your hull's gathering space dust.
progress: You've got {gold} credits! Ship upgrade time? 🌌
update: Galactic news: STARWRIGHT now v{version}! New stars?
